content:
maria: Heads up — I'm about to open a TF change to the gpupool module to add a preemption_priority attribute and a lease_rebalance_window. It's to support the AZ fallback behavior we're testing. Anyone see immediate red flags?

alex: Can you paste the terraform diff? Small module bumps are ok but I'm worried about gitops drift for clusters still on v3.x.

maria: Diff snippet: 
```hcl
module "gpupool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.company.com/infra/tf-gpupool.git?ref=v3.2.0"
  preemption_priority    = "low"
  lease_rebalance_window = "180s"
}
```

suresh: FWIW this touches the autoscaler hook. We should canary in eu-west-1 only. Also watch the iam_role var rename in the module — state import pain if we drop the old name.

kelly: +1 on canary. Keep the old var as an alias in the module to avoid state import. Make this a minor semver bump and add a release note with migration steps.

infra-ci: Canary pipeline triggered: gpupool/pr/412 — running `terraform plan` and helm smoke tests :gear: (canary targets: eu-west-1a,b).

deploy-bot: Plan completed for gpupool/pr/412 — no destructive actions detected. 3 modules will be updated: gpupool, gpufleet-shared, autoscaler-hook.

alex: Quick question on KMS/IAM: does preemption_priority require any new permissions? Preemption itself no, but lease_rebalance_window may interact with node-termination webhook configmap updates.

maria: Confirmed: no new KMS keys or IAM policies. The webhook config is managed by the helm chart; TF will only update a launch template tag that the webhook reads.

suresh: Please add a migration helper to avoid mass lease churn. Suggest `scripts/migrate_leases.py --drain-grace 120` to gracefully convert existing leases to the new window. Otherwise rolling apply can churn many nodes.

kelly: I'll wire a post-apply hook in the gitops pipeline to run the migration against the canary cluster only. Also adding monitoring alerts for lease-adoption-rate.

maria: Merging to canary in ~15m. Tagging @eng-oncall and leaving a rollback plan: provider alias revert to v3.2.0 and revert tag on gpupool module. :warning:

syd: Noted — I'll watch node capacity and set a temporary quota floor to avoid oversubscription. If eviction rate > 5% in 5m we trigger rollback.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post perf + reclaim metrics here after the canary run. :eyes:
